sentences.en: In 2011, the body of a woman was discovered in a California vineyard.
sentences.zh: 2011年，一名女性的遗体在加利福尼亚州的一处葡萄园被发现。

sentences.en: She had been decapitated, and her body had been drained of blood.
sentences.zh: 她遭到了斩首，体内的血液也被排干。

sentences.en: It appeared her killer had gone to extraordinary lengths to conceal her identity.
sentences.zh: 凶手似乎费尽心机想要隐瞒她的身份。

sentences.en: For more than a decade, she was known only as Jane Doe.
sentences.zh: 十多年来，她一直被称为“简·多伊”（无名氏）。

sentences.en: Then, detectives finally learned her name, Ada.
sentences.zh: 后来，侦探们终于查明了她的名字——艾达。

sentences.en: But, identifying her only made this bizarre murder even more perplexing.
sentences.zh: 然而，确认她的身份反而让这起离奇的谋杀案变得更加扑朔迷离。

sentences.en: Ada is the new series from Casefile Presents, available now wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 《艾达》是Casefile Presents推出的全新系列节目，现已在各大播客平台上线。

sentences.en: This episode involves a crime against children.
sentences.zh: 本集涉及针对儿童的犯罪。

sentences.en: It may not be suitable for all listeners.
sentences.zh: 可能不适合所有听众收听。

sentences.en: Margaret Hobbs was no stranger to sex offenders.
sentences.zh: 玛格丽特·霍布斯对性犯罪者并不陌生。

sentences.en: After working as a parole officer for many years, she had become a psychotherapist and ran her own private practice in the inner-city Victorian suburb of Fitzroy.
sentences.zh: 在担任多年假释官后，她转行成为了一名心理治疗师，并在墨尔本市中心的维多利亚式郊区菲茨罗伊经营着自己的私人诊所。

sentences.en: Margaret had treated killers and various other criminals, but her specialty was in providing therapy to men who had committed sexually-based offences.
sentences.zh: 玛格丽特治疗过杀人犯和其他各类罪犯，但她的专长是为犯下性犯罪的男性提供心理治疗。

sentences.en: As well as counselling these individuals, Margaret reported on them to the courts, and
sentences.zh: 除了为这些人提供咨询，玛格丽特还会向法院提交关于他们的报告，并且

sentences.en: over the course of 20 years, almost every convicted sex offender in Melbourne had been referred to her at one time or another.
sentences.zh: 在过去的20年里，墨尔本几乎每一位被定罪的性犯罪者都曾被转介给她。

sentences.en: Due to the difficult nature of her work, Margaret had grown adept at compartmentalising her life.
sentences.zh: 由于工作性质艰巨，玛格丽特变得非常擅长将生活进行“隔断”。

sentences.en: Professional and compassionate, she was able to present her composed mask to her clients, even when they spoke of having done terrible things.
sentences.zh: 她专业且富有同情心，即便在客户谈论自己所做的可怕行径时，她也能在对方面前保持冷静的面具。

sentences.en: After each working day was over, Margaret would retreat to her home in the Dandenong Ranges,
sentences.zh: 每天工作结束后，玛格丽特都会回到位于丹德农山脉的家中，

sentences.en: a striking region on the eastern fringes of Melbourne that is characterised by rolling hills, tall mountain ash trees, and dense, ferny foliage.
sentences.zh: 那是一个位于墨尔本东郊的迷人地区，以连绵起伏的丘陵、高大的山灰树和茂密的蕨类植物为特色。

sentences.en: Weekends were a chance to completely switch off.
sentences.zh: 周末是她彻底放松的机会。

sentences.en: Nestled in her picturesque setting, Margaret completely avoided all news reports and instead spent her time reading and writing.
sentences.zh: 在风景如画的环境中，玛格丽特完全避开了所有新闻报道，转而把时间花在阅读和写作上。

sentences.en: One day in November 1984, Margaret was preparing to meet a new client.
sentences.zh: 1984年11月的一天，玛格丽特正准备见一位新客户。

sentences.en: 47-year-old Robert Arthur Selby Lowe.
sentences.zh: 47岁的罗伯特·亚瑟·塞尔比·洛。

sentences.en: His lawyers had referred him to Margaret in anticipation of an upcoming hearing.
sentences.zh: 他的律师为了应对即将到来的听证会，将他转介给了玛格丽特。

sentences.en: Robert Lowe had exposed himself to some schoolgirls at a shopping centre near his home and made some lewd remarks.
sentences.zh: 罗伯特·洛曾在住所附近的一家购物中心向几名女学生暴露身体，并说了些下流话。

sentences.en: He'd been charged and was set to appear in a magistrate's court, so his defence team needed a report they could present.
sentences.zh: 他已被起诉并准备在治安法院出庭，因此他的辩护团队需要一份可以呈交的报告。

sentences.en: When Margaret greeted Lowe, she noted that he didn't look like most of her other clients.
sentences.zh: 当玛格丽特迎接洛时，她注意到他看起来与她的大多数其他客户不同。

sentences.en: He was of average height with a lean build and dressed in exceptionally neat clothes.
sentences.zh: 他中等身材，体型偏瘦，穿着格外整洁。

sentences.en: His light-coloured, slightly curly hair was beginning to turn grey, and his eyes were framed by fine-rimmed glasses.
sentences.zh: 他浅色、微卷的头发开始变灰，鼻梁上架着一副细框眼镜。

sentences.en: When Lowe spoke, Margaret detected a polished English accent.
sentences.zh: 当洛开口说话时，玛格丽特听出了他带有优雅的英式口音。

sentences.en: She found him to be exceedingly polite and well-mannered.
sentences.zh: 她发现他非常有礼貌，举止得体。

sentences.en: As well as working as a salesperson, Robert Lowe volunteered his time to the community as a church elder, a Sunday school teacher, and a children's sports coach.
sentences.zh: 除了担任销售员，罗伯特·洛还作为教会长老、主日学校老师和儿童体育教练，将自己的时间贡献给社区。

sentences.en: He had been married for more than a decade and had two sons.
sentences.zh: 他结婚十多年，有两个儿子。

sentences.en: With a ready smile and a respectful air, Lowe appeared in every way to be an upstanding member of society.
sentences.zh: 洛总是带着微笑，神态恭敬，看起来完全是一个正直的社会成员。

sentences.en: And yet, from almost the first moment that Margaret Hobbs met Robert Lowe, there was something about him that made her skin crawl.
sentences.zh: 然而，几乎在玛格丽特·霍布斯见到罗伯特·洛的第一刻起，他身上就有一种让她毛骨悚然的东西。

sentences.en: The obscene exposure charge that had led to Margaret Hobbs meeting Robert Lowe proceeded to court.
sentences.zh: 导致玛格丽特·霍布斯与罗伯特·洛见面的猥亵暴露指控进入了司法程序。

sentences.en: Lowe was given a one-year good behaviour bond, on the proviso that he begins seeing Margaret regularly for therapy sessions.
sentences.zh: 洛被判处一年行为良好保证金，前提是他必须开始定期接受玛格丽特的心理治疗。

sentences.en: He agreed.
sentences.zh: 他同意了。

sentences.en: At first, Lowe denied that he had done anything wrong, despite being charged with a crime.
sentences.zh: 起初，尽管被指控犯罪，洛仍否认自己做错了任何事。

sentences.en: He explained that he had not exposed himself to the schoolgirls, as doing so was against the law.
sentences.zh: 他解释说他没有向女学生暴露身体，因为这样做是违法的。

sentences.en: He had spoken to them, but Lowe pointed out that this was not a crime.
sentences.zh: 他确实和她们说过话，但洛指出这并不构成犯罪。

sentences.en: Yet, Margaret was soon able to coax some admissions from him.
sentences.zh: 然而，玛格丽特很快就诱导他说出了一些实情。

sentences.en: Lowe acknowledged that he had been previously convicted on one count of indecent exposure and one of theft.
sentences.zh: 洛承认他之前曾因一项猥亵暴露罪和一项盗窃罪被定罪。

sentences.en: Despite his respectable appearance, steady job, and solid home life, there was something about
sentences.zh: 尽管他外表体面、工作稳定、家庭生活稳固，但关于

sentences.en: Lowe that made Margaret intuitively suspicious of him.
sentences.zh: 洛的某些特质还是让玛格丽特凭直觉对他产生了怀疑。

sentences.en: He visited for regular sessions and always arrived right on time, armed with a neat sheaf of papers on which he would jot down notes as they talked.
sentences.zh: 他定期来参加治疗，总是准时到达，随身带着一叠整齐的纸，谈话时会在上面记笔记。

sentences.en: But Margaret sensed that his efforts to change his behaviour were insincere.
sentences.zh: 但玛格丽特感觉到他改变行为的努力并不真诚。

sentences.en: He minimised and denied the nature of his crimes and was a habitual liar.
sentences.zh: 他淡化并否认自己罪行的性质，而且是个惯犯说谎者。

sentences.en: His dishonesty was often characterised by sly omissions or denying something on a technicality.
sentences.zh: 他的不诚实通常表现为狡猾的遗漏，或者在技术细节上进行抵赖。

sentences.en: In a book titled The Evil, co-authored by Margaret Hobbs and journalist Andrew Rule, Margaret described
sentences.zh: 在玛格丽特·霍布斯与记者安德鲁·鲁尔合著的《邪恶》一书中，玛格丽特描述了

sentences.en: Lowe's slippery way of avoiding the truth.
sentences.zh: 洛那种逃避真相的狡猾方式。

sentences.en: Ask him if he has a blue car and he will say, certainly not.
sentences.zh: 问他是否有辆蓝色轿车，他会说，当然没有。

sentences.en: If you change the question slightly and ask him if he drives a blue car, he will say yes, but point out that he doesn't own it.
sentences.zh: 如果你稍微改变一下问题，问他是否开一辆蓝色轿车，他会说有，但会指出那辆车不是他的。

sentences.en: Over time, Lowe admitted to more and more crimes, predominantly indecent exposure and theft.
sentences.zh: 随着时间的推移，洛承认了越来越多的罪行，主要是猥亵暴露和盗窃。

sentences.en: As he became more comfortable with Margaret, Lowe told her how he often exposed himself to young girls.
sentences.zh: 当他与玛格丽特相处得更自在时，洛告诉她他是如何经常向年轻女孩暴露身体的。

sentences.en: Sometimes he deliberately placed items of pornography that he'd stolen in full view of his victims, hoping to shock them with the material.
sentences.zh: 有时他会故意把他偷来的色情物品放在受害者视线范围内，希望能用这些材料震惊她们。

sentences.en: He had committed these acts in his homeland of England and his adopted country of New Zealand, as well as Australia, where he had settled in 1967.
sentences.zh: 他在自己的祖国英国、移居国新西兰以及1967年定居的澳大利亚都犯下过这些罪行。

sentences.en: Yet, thanks to his skilful lying, he was rarely convicted.
sentences.zh: 然而，多亏了他高超的谎言，他很少被定罪。

sentences.en: When Lowe was charged, his punishment usually came in the form of a small fine.
sentences.zh: 当洛被指控时，他的惩罚通常只是小额罚款。

sentences.en: Sometimes he received good behaviour bonds.
sentences.zh: 有时他会收到行为良好保证金。

sentences.en: He lived in the eastern suburb of Glen Waverley, but his work as a travelling salesperson meant he visited a wide range of areas.
sentences.zh: 他住在东郊的格伦韦弗利，但作为一名旅行销售员，他的工作意味着他会去很多地方。

sentences.en: This enabled him to operate more stealthily than if he always struck in the same neighbourhood.
sentences.zh: 这使他比总是盯着同一个社区作案更隐蔽。

sentences.en: In 1985, Robert Lowe's good behaviour bond expired and he was no longer required to attend therapy.
sentences.zh: 1985年，罗伯特·洛的行为良好保证金到期，他不再需要接受治疗。

sentences.en: But, he kept scheduling the occasional appointment with Margaret, or sometimes he called her on the phone.
sentences.zh: 但是，他还是会偶尔预约玛格丽特，或者有时给她打电话。

sentences.en: She felt as though he got off on telling her about the obscene things that he'd done.
sentences.zh: 她觉得他从向她讲述自己所做的猥亵行为中获得了快感。

sentences.en: By April of 1990, Robert Lowe had been in and out of Margaret Hobbs' life for five and a half years.
sentences.zh: 到1990年4月，罗伯特·洛已经在玛格丽特·霍布斯的生活中进进出出了五年半。

sentences.en: One day, he arrived for an appointment and almost immediately announced that some police officers had just visited his workplace.
sentences.zh: 一天，他来赴约，几乎立刻宣布有一些警察刚刚去过他的工作场所。

sentences.en: They had wanted to question him about an attempted child abduction.
sentences.zh: 他们想就一起未遂的绑架儿童案对他进行盘问。

sentences.en: Margaret was shocked.
sentences.zh: 玛格丽特感到震惊。

sentences.en: What happened, she asked.
sentences.zh: 她问，发生了什么事？

sentences.en: Lowe claimed that he hadn't done anything wrong.
sentences.zh: 洛声称他没做错任何事。

sentences.en: He'd just stopped to talk to some schoolgirls in the inner northern suburb of Northcote while he was in the area for work.
sentences.zh: 他只是在北部的内郊区诺斯科特工作时，顺便停下来和几个女学生说了几句话。

sentences.en: By now, Margaret recognised when Lowe was attempting to minimise a crime.
sentences.zh: 此时，玛格丽特已经能识别出洛何时在试图淡化罪行。

sentences.en: Gently, she tried coaxing more information from him with carefully phrased questions.
sentences.zh: 她温和地尝试用精心措辞的问题从他那里诱导出更多信息。

sentences.en: He eventually admitted that he'd seen the girls as he was driving down the street they were on, so he pulled over and approached them.
sentences.zh: 他最终承认，当他开车经过那条街时看到了那些女孩，于是他靠边停车并接近了她们。

sentences.en: Lowe attempted to engage the girls in conversation, but when a woman emerged from a nearby shop and stared at him, he decided to leave.
sentences.zh: 洛试图与女孩们搭话，但当一名妇女从附近的商店出来盯着他看时，他决定离开。

sentences.en: As he walked away, he noticed a little girl playing in the front garden of her home.
sentences.zh: 当他走开时，他注意到一个小女孩正在自家前院玩耍。

sentences.en: Did you speak to her, Margaret asked, as described in her book, The Evil.
sentences.zh: 正如她在《邪恶》一书中所述，玛格丽特问他，你和她说话了吗？

sentences.en: Lowe said he hadn't.
sentences.zh: 洛说他没有。

sentences.en: Well, did she speak to you then, Margaret persisted.
sentences.zh: 玛格丽特追问道，那么，是她先和你说话的吗？

sentences.en: Yes, I think she did.
sentences.zh: 是的，我想是的。

sentences.en: But I didn't speak to her firSt.
sentences.zh: 但我没有先和她说话。

sentences.en: Lowe sounded smug.
sentences.zh: 洛听起来很自鸣得意。

sentences.en: Margaret asked if he had suggested that the little girl go somewhere with him.
sentences.zh: 玛格丽特问他是否曾暗示让那个小女孩和他一起去某个地方。

sentences.en: He gave a vague reply.
sentences.zh: 他给出了一个模糊的回答。

sentences.en: I may have.
sentences.zh: 我可能说过。

sentences.en: I don't know.
sentences.zh: 我不知道。

sentences.en: Margaret was deeply disturbed.
sentences.zh: 玛格丽特深感不安。

sentences.en: She couldn't help but feel that her client had crossed a whole new line in his offending.
sentences.zh: 她不禁觉得，她的客户在犯罪道路上跨越了一条全新的底线。

sentences.en: She next saw Lowe about one month later.
sentences.zh: 她大约一个月后再次见到了洛。

sentences.en: He hadn't been charged for the attempted abduction, but he revealed that the police were now investigating him for something else.
sentences.zh: 他没有因那起未遂绑架案被起诉，但他透露警方现在正因另一件事调查他。

sentences.en: This time, he had just tried to chat with some 12-year-old girls he'd seen at Flinders Street train station in Melbourne's CBD.
sentences.zh: 这一次，他只是试图和他在墨尔本中央商务区弗林德斯街火车站看到的几个12岁女孩聊天。

sentences.en: Moments after this innocent conversation, a suspicious police officer had approached out of the blue and arrested him.
sentences.zh: 在这段看似无辜的谈话后不久，一名警觉的警察突然走过来逮捕了他。

sentences.en: Lowe asked if Margaret's son-in-law, who was a solicitor, could represent him.
sentences.zh: 洛问玛格丽特的女婿（一名律师）是否可以为他辩护。

sentences.en: His office was in the same building as Margaret's.
sentences.zh: 他的办公室就在玛格丽特所在的同一栋楼里。

sentences.en: After Lowe left, Margaret decided to look into the matter further.
sentences.zh: 洛离开后，玛格丽特决定进一步调查此事。

sentences.en: She called the police officer who had interviewed Lowe about the matter to hear his version of events.
sentences.zh: 她打电话给那位就此事审问过洛的警官，想听听他的说法。

sentences.en: The officer told Margaret that the girls were younger than Lowe described, approximately between 8 and 10 years old.
sentences.zh: 警官告诉玛格丽特，那些女孩比洛描述的要小，大约在8到10岁之间。

sentences.en: They had been standing on a railway platform holding some balloons when Lowe walked up to them and said the balloons looked like, quote, big dicks.
sentences.zh: 她们当时正站在站台上拿着气球，洛走过去对她们说，气球看起来像“大鸡巴”。

sentences.en: Then he asked if they'd like to go somewhere with him, quote, for sex.
sentences.zh: 然后他问她们是否想和他一起去某个地方，“做爱”。

sentences.en: The terrified children ran away and flagged down a police officer.
sentences.zh: 受惊的孩子们跑开了，并向一名警察求助。

sentences.en: When the officer approached Lowe, he fled and had to be tackled to the ground.
sentences.zh: 当警察接近洛时，他逃跑了，最后被扑倒在地。

sentences.en: It was obvious that Lowe couldn't be trusted.
sentences.zh: 很明显，洛根本不可信。

sentences.en: He was playing down his crimes and lying about the details.
sentences.zh: 他在淡化自己的罪行，并在细节上撒谎。

sentences.en: Moreover, his victims were getting younger and he was becoming bolder.
sentences.zh: 此外，他的受害者越来越小，他也变得越来越大胆。

sentences.en: Instead of just exposing himself, now he was attempting to engage girls in conversation and lure them away, out in public, in the middle of the day.
sentences.zh: 他不再仅仅是暴露自己，现在他试图在大白天、在公共场合与女孩搭话并将她们诱骗走。

sentences.en: Robert Lowe was soon charged over the incident at Flinders Street Station.
sentences.zh: 罗伯特·洛很快就弗林德斯街车站的事件受到了指控。

sentences.en: He asked Margaret to write a report that could be used as part of his defence as he was planning to plead not guilty.
sentences.zh: 他要求玛格丽特写一份报告作为辩护的一部分，因为他打算做无罪抗辩。

sentences.en: Angered by his decision, Margaret initially refused.
sentences.zh: 玛格丽特对他的决定感到愤怒，起初拒绝了。

sentences.en: She knew that Lowe was guilty and was upset that he was defending the charges.
sentences.zh: 她知道洛是有罪的，并对他在为这些指控做辩护感到不满。

sentences.en: By pleading not guilty, he would be forcing his young victims to testify at trial and exacerbating their suffering.
sentences.zh: 通过做无罪抗辩，他将迫使年幼的受害者在审判中作证，从而加剧她们的痛苦。

sentences.en: When she questioned why he wouldn't just admit what he had done, Lowe smiled and replied, You know me, Mug.
sentences.zh: 当她质问他为什么不直接承认自己的所作所为时，洛微笑着回答：“你了解我的，玛格。”

sentences.en: What do you think I pay lawyers for?
sentences.zh: “你以为我付钱给律师是为了什么？”

sentences.en: Margaret had had enough.
sentences.zh: 玛格丽特受够了。

sentences.en: It was clear that Lowe had no remorse and no desire to stop his criminal behaviour.
sentences.zh: 很明显，洛毫无悔意，也没有停止犯罪行为的意愿。

sentences.en: He wasn't treating therapy seriously and instead seemed to take a perverse pleasure in the time they spent together.
sentences.zh: 他并没有认真对待治疗，反而似乎从他们在一起的时间里获得了一种变态的快感。

sentences.en: Calmly, Margaret asked her client to leave, stating,
sentences.zh: 玛格丽特平静地要求她的客户离开，并说道：

sentences.en: I really don't think I want anything else to do with you.
sentences.zh: “我真的不想再和你有什么瓜葛了。”

sentences.en: It's obvious you're not benefiting from coming here.
sentences.zh: “很明显，你来这里并没有得到任何帮助。”

sentences.en: In fact, I think you're getting worse.
sentences.zh: “事实上，我觉得你变得更糟了。”

sentences.en: Shocked by her demand, Lowe refused to leave.
sentences.zh: 洛对她的要求感到震惊，拒绝离开。

sentences.en: But Margaret insisted.
sentences.zh: 但玛格丽特坚持要求他离开。

sentences.en: Realising he was fighting a losing battle, Lowe stormed out of her office, slamming the door as he went.
sentences.zh: 意识到自己是在做无谓的挣扎，洛冲出了她的办公室，走时重重地摔上了门。

sentences.en: Eventually, Margaret did agree to provide a court report, but it was a damning one.
sentences.zh: 最终，玛格丽特确实同意提供一份法庭报告，但那是一份严厉的报告。

sentences.en: She made a point of noting how dangerous Lowe's behaviour was.
sentences.zh: 她特意指出洛的行为有多么危险。

sentences.en: Proper punishment would be the only deterrent.
sentences.zh: 适当的惩罚是唯一的威慑手段。

sentences.en: After reading what the psychotherapist had written, Lowe's lawyer decided not to submit her report.
sentences.zh: 在读完心理治疗师写的内容后，洛的律师决定不提交她的报告。

sentences.en: It would only harm his client's defence.
sentences.zh: 那只会损害他客户的辩护。

sentences.en: In November of 1990, Lowe was convicted of harassing the children at Flinders Street Station and fined $700.
sentences.zh: 1990年11月，洛因骚扰弗林德斯街车站的儿童被判有罪，并被罚款700美元。

sentences.en: When Margaret Hobbs heard the sentencing, she was very concerned.
sentences.zh: 当玛格丽特·霍布斯听到判决时，她非常担心。

sentences.en: Surely, such a paltry fine would only serve to further convince Robert Lowe that he had done nothing wrong.
sentences.zh: 毫无疑问，这种微不足道的罚款只会让罗伯特·洛更加确信自己没有做错任何事。

sentences.en: And, most likely, he would go on to commit more offences with impunity.
sentences.zh: 而且，他很可能会继续肆无忌惮地犯下更多罪行。

sentences.en: Months ticked by and Margaret Hobbs moved on.
sentences.zh: 几个月过去了，玛格丽特·霍布斯继续着自己的生活。

sentences.en: She was no longer treating Robert Lowe and didn't miss his absence from her life.
sentences.zh: 她不再治疗罗伯特·洛，也没有因为他的缺席而感到失落。

sentences.en: By the start of July 1991, it had been more than six months since she'd seen him.
sentences.zh: 到1991年7月初，她已经有半年多没见过他了。

sentences.en: On the morning of Tuesday July 1, Margaret was making the long drive from her home in the Dandenongs to her office in Melbourne.
sentences.zh: 7月1日星期二早上，玛格丽特正开车从丹德农的家中前往墨尔本的办公室。

sentences.en: It was the first day of her working week, and as per usual, she had avoided the news all weekend long.
sentences.zh: 这是她工作周的第一天，像往常一样，她整个周末都没有看新闻。

sentences.en: As Margaret drove, she switched on her car radio and listened as a presenter ran through the latest headlines.
sentences.zh: 当玛格丽特开车时，她打开车载收音机，听着主持人播报最新的头条新闻。

sentences.en: The lead story was about a little girl who had gone missing over the weekend on Victoria's Mornington Peninsula.
sentences.zh: 头条新闻是关于一个周末在维多利亚州莫宁顿半岛失踪的小女孩。

sentences.en: Just before 2pm on Saturday June 29 in the seaside town of Rosebud, six-year-old Cherie Beasley had ridden her bike to a local milk bar to pick up some things for her mum.
sentences.zh: 6月29日星期六下午2点前，在海滨小镇罗斯巴德，6岁的切丽·比斯利骑着自行车去当地的一家牛奶吧为妈妈买东西。

sentences.en: Almost half an hour later, her bright pink bicycle was found abandoned in a nearby residential street.
sentences.zh: 大约半小时后，她那辆亮粉色的自行车在附近的一条住宅街道上被发现，已被遗弃。

sentences.en: A large-scale search of the region and its surrounding bushland had found no trace of the little girl.
sentences.zh: 对该地区及其周边丛林进行的大规模搜寻没有发现这个小女孩的踪迹。

sentences.en: Police believed Cherie had been abducted and held grey fears for her safety.
sentences.zh: 警方认为切丽遭到了绑架，并对她的安全深感担忧。

sentences.en: They were on the lookout for a blue Toyota Corolla.
sentences.zh: 他们正在寻找一辆蓝色的丰田卡罗拉。

sentences.en: Although she hadn't seen him in months, her mind immediately went to Robert Lowe.
sentences.zh: 尽管她已经几个月没见过他了，但她的脑海里立刻浮现出罗伯特·洛的身影。

sentences.en: She knew that he and his wife owned a holiday home in Rosebud, which was a popular tourist destination in the summer months.
sentences.zh: 她知道他和妻子在罗斯巴德拥有一处度假屋，那里是夏季的热门旅游目的地。

sentences.en: Cherie Beasley's age and gender fit with Lowe's general pattern of victiMs.
sentences.zh: 切丽·比斯利的年龄和性别符合洛的一般受害者模式。

sentences.en: And Margaret had long suspected that his crimes were escalating.
sentences.zh: 而且玛格丽特早就怀疑他的罪行在不断升级。

sentences.en: But she had no idea what sort of car he drove, and there was nothing tangible that pointed to him as the suspect.
sentences.zh: 但她不知道他开什么车，也没有任何实质性的证据指向他是嫌疑人。

sentences.en: Perhaps she was just being paranoid.
sentences.zh: 也许她只是太敏感了。

sentences.en: With nothing more than a hunch to go on, Margaret kept her suspicions to herself.
sentences.zh: 由于仅仅是一个预感，玛格丽特把怀疑藏在了心里。

sentences.en: As the days passed, Margaret Hobbs kept an eye on the news.
sentences.zh: 随着日子一天天过去，玛格丽特·霍布斯一直密切关注着新闻。

sentences.en: Cherie Beasley's school portrait was regularly featured in updates, depicting her freckled face, bright blue eyes, long brown hair, and cheeky smile.
sentences.zh: 切丽·比斯利的学校证件照经常出现在新闻更新中，照片上她长着满是雀斑的脸、明亮的蓝眼睛、棕色的长发，还有那顽皮的笑容。

sentences.en: Yet, there was still no sign of the six-year-old.
sentences.zh: 然而，这个六岁女孩依然下落不明。

sentences.en: Nor had police arrested anybody, or indicated that they knew who might be responsible.
sentences.zh: 警方既没有逮捕任何人，也没有透露他们是否知道谁可能对此负责。

sentences.en: Some Victorians worried that Cherie was yet another victim of the unidentified serial child rapist that the media had dubbed Mr Cruel.
sentences.zh: 一些维多利亚州人担心，切丽是媒体所称的“残酷先生”——那个身份不明的连环虐童案凶手的又一名受害者。

sentences.en: Covered in episode 41 of Case File,
sentences.zh: 在《案件档案》第41集中曾提到，

sentences.en: Mr Cruel attacked several girls in Melbourne's northern and eastern suburbs during the late 1980s and early 90s.
sentences.zh: “残酷先生”在20世纪80年代末和90年代初袭击了墨尔本北部和东部郊区的几名女孩。

sentences.en: Mr Cruel was also the main suspect in the abduction of 13-year-old Carmen Chan, who was taken from her home almost three months before Cherie Beasley vanished.
sentences.zh: “残酷先生”也是13岁女孩卡门·陈绑架案的主要嫌疑人，她在切丽·比斯利失踪前近三个月从家中被带走。

sentences.en: But, despite these concerns about Mr Cruel, it was Robert Lowe who Margaret Hobbs couldn't stop thinking about.
sentences.zh: 但是，尽管人们对“残酷先生”感到担忧，玛格丽特·霍布斯却始终无法停止对罗伯特·洛的怀疑。

sentences.en: By Monday July 29, exactly one month had passed since Cherie's abduction.
sentences.zh: 到了7月29日星期一，距离切丽被绑架正好过去了一个月。

sentences.en: That same afternoon, Margaret received a surprise at work.
sentences.zh: 就在那天下午，玛格丽特在工作中收到了一份“惊喜”。

sentences.en: She was in her office when her son-in-law's receptionist, Danielle, appeared at her door.
sentences.zh: 当时她正在办公室里，她女婿的接待员丹妮尔出现在门口。

sentences.en: Danielle worked downstairs, where Margaret's son-in-law had a law firm.
sentences.zh: 丹妮尔在楼下工作，玛格丽特的女婿在那里开了一家律师事务所。

sentences.en: A client had arrived at the building wanting to speak about a legal matter, but Margaret's son-in-law wasn't in.
sentences.zh: 一位客户来到大楼想咨询法律问题，但玛格丽特的女婿不在。

sentences.en: Would Margaret be willing to talk to the client instead?
sentences.zh: 玛格丽特愿意代为接待这位客户吗？

sentences.en: It was Robert Lowe.
sentences.zh: 来人正是罗伯特·洛。

sentences.en: Margaret hadn't seen Lowe since his court hearing at the end of the previous year.
sentences.zh: 自去年年底的法庭听证会后，玛格丽特就再没见过洛。

sentences.en: She agreed to speak with him, and Danielle sent him upstairs.
sentences.zh: 她同意与他交谈，于是丹妮尔让他上楼。

sentences.en: Margaret immediately noticed he looked different.
sentences.zh: 玛格丽特立刻注意到他看起来有些不同。

sentences.en: Lowe had always dressed smartly, but that day his jacket clashed with his trousers and tie.
sentences.zh: 洛一向穿着考究，但那天他的夹克与裤子和领带很不搭。

sentences.en: Instead of smiling and making polite chit-chat like he usually did, he was rude and upset.
sentences.zh: 他没有像往常那样微笑并进行礼貌的寒暄，而是表现得粗鲁且心烦意乱。

sentences.en: Lowe explained that he'd come to see Margaret's son-in-law about a bill before launching into a tirade
sentences.zh: 洛解释说他是来找玛格丽特的女婿谈账单问题的，随后便开始长篇大论地抱怨

sentences.en: about the negative court report she had written for him months earlier in relation to the Flinders Street Station incident.
sentences.zh: 几个月前她为他写的关于弗林德斯街车站事件的负面法庭报告。

sentences.en: Agitated and irritable, Lowe laughed abruptly.
sentences.zh: 洛显得焦躁不安，突然大笑起来。

sentences.en: His erratic behaviour was out of character and only served to increase Margaret's suspicions.
sentences.zh: 他这种反常的行为与往日判若两人，这只会加深玛格丽特的怀疑。

sentences.en: She went downstairs and asked Danielle whether she had seen what sort of car Lowe had been driving.
sentences.zh: 她下楼问丹妮尔是否看清了洛开的是什么车。

sentences.en: The receptionist replied that she hadn't.
sentences.zh: 接待员回答说没有。

sentences.en: But the next morning, she surprised Margaret by saying Lowe had looted in the area longer than they realised.
sentences.zh: 但第二天早上，她给了玛格丽特一个意外的消息，说洛在那个区域停留的时间比他们意识到的要长。

sentences.en: Shortly after Margaret left for the day, he too had driven away from the premises.
sentences.zh: 在玛格丽特离开后不久，他也开车离开了现场。

sentences.en: In a blue Toyota Corolla.
sentences.zh: 开的是一辆蓝色丰田卡罗拉。

sentences.en: Two weeks later, Margaret received a phone call from Robert Lowe.
sentences.zh: 两周后，玛格丽特接到了罗伯特·洛的电话。

sentences.en: Some detectives had shown up at his house early in the morning.
sentences.zh: 当天清晨，几名侦探出现在他家门口。

sentences.en: His prior criminal record and the blue Toyota Corolla he drove had brought them to his door.
sentences.zh: 他之前的犯罪记录和他驾驶的蓝色丰田卡罗拉将他们引向了他。

sentences.en: Lowe didn't own the vehicle, it belonged to his employer, but he used it daily.
sentences.zh: 洛并不拥有那辆车，那是他雇主的，但他每天都在使用。

sentences.en: Lowe hadn't wanted to let the detectives inside, but when they presented him with a search warrant
sentences.zh: 洛本不想让侦探进屋，但当他们出示了搜查令，

sentences.en: and informed him he was suspected of abducting six-year-old Cherie Beasley, he had no other option.
sentences.zh: 并告知他涉嫌绑架六岁的切丽·比斯利时，他别无选择。

sentences.en: Lowe's wife and sons were shocked and confused by the sudden influx of police officers to their home.
sentences.zh: 洛的妻子和儿子们对突然涌入家中的警察感到震惊和困惑。

sentences.en: The family all held hands in the kitchen while Lowe prayed aloud.
sentences.zh: 全家人在厨房里手牵着手，而洛则大声祈祷。

sentences.en: Then, some of the detectives informed Lowe that they would be taking his car in for a forensic examination
sentences.zh: 随后，一些侦探通知洛，他们要带走他的车进行法医鉴定。

sentences.en: As they bundled him into a police car, other officers continued searching the Lowe family home.
sentences.zh: 当他们把他押进警车时，其他警官继续搜查洛的家。

sentences.en: Upon arriving at Melbourne's police headquarters, Robert Lowe was permitted to make a phone call.
sentences.zh: 抵达墨尔本警察总部后，罗伯特·洛被允许打一个电话。

sentences.en: As described in the book The Evil, he dialed Margaret Hobbs' number and told her,
sentences.zh: 正如书《邪恶》中所述，他拨通了玛格丽特·霍布斯的电话，对她说：

sentences.en: I'm in real trouble, could you suggest the best lawyer available?
sentences.zh: “我遇到了大麻烦，你能推荐一位最好的律师吗？”

sentences.en: Margaret suggested he stick with the lawyer that he already had, and the call concluded.
sentences.zh: 玛格丽特建议他继续聘用现有的律师，通话随即结束。

sentences.en: The following month, she heard from Lowe again when he scheduled his first appointment with her
sentences.zh: 次月，她再次接到了洛的电话，他预约了近一年来的第一次咨询，

sentences.en: in almost a year, the first since she had told him she didn't want to treat him anymore.
sentences.zh: 这也是自她告诉他不再为他治疗以来的第一次。

sentences.en: It turned out that detectives had questioned Lowe for more than four hours, but he had resisted their efforts to obtain his fingerprints or a blood sample.
sentences.zh: 原来侦探们审讯了洛四个多小时，但他拒绝配合提取指纹或血样。

sentences.en: They had to let him go, as they had no actual evidence to hold him.
sentences.zh: 他们不得不放了他，因为没有实际证据扣留他。

sentences.en: Lowe turned up for his appointment looking messy and dishevelled.
sentences.zh: 洛来赴约时，看起来邋遢且凌乱。

sentences.en: As he explained to Margaret,
sentences.zh: 正如他向玛格丽特解释的那样：

sentences.en: Things have gone off the rails a bit since you threw me out.
sentences.zh: “自从你把我赶走后，一切都有点失控了。”

sentences.en: Investigators had informed Lowe's family what he was suspected of and questioned them at length.
sentences.zh: 调查人员已将洛的嫌疑告知了他的家人，并对他们进行了长时间的盘问。

sentences.en: None of them had been able to provide him with an alibi for the afternoon of Cherie's disappearance,
sentences.zh: 他们都没能为他提供切丽失踪那天下午的不在场证明，

sentences.en: with Lorraine telling investigators that she and her husband had attended a prayer meeting at their church in the morning.
sentences.zh: 洛林告诉调查人员，她和丈夫当天上午参加了教会的祈祷会。

sentences.en: When the meeting ended at 10.45, Lowe told Lorraine and some other churchgoers that he planned to go to Rosebud to carry out some repairs on their holiday home.
sentences.zh: 会议在10点45分结束时，洛告诉洛林和其他教友，他打算去罗斯巴德修理度假屋。

sentences.en: Rosebud was roughly an hour's drive from the couple's house in Glen Waverley.
sentences.zh: 罗斯巴德距离这对夫妇在格伦韦弗利的家大约有一小时车程。

sentences.en: Lorraine went home alone that morning.
sentences.zh: 那天早上，洛林独自回了家。

sentences.en: Despite multiple people hearing Lowe say he was going to Rosebud that day, he claimed to have no recollection of travelling to the area.
sentences.zh: 尽管有多人听到洛说那天要去罗斯巴德，但他声称不记得去过那个地区。

sentences.en: Later, he amended this to say he had driven to his holiday home but had finished making the repairs by 12.50
sentences.zh: 后来，他改口说他确实开车去了度假屋，但在12点50分就完成了修理工作，

sentences.en: and was back in Glen Waverley by 2pm, shortly before Cherie was abducted.
sentences.zh: 并在下午2点前回到格伦韦弗利，就在切丽被绑架前不久。

sentences.en: But Lorraine disputed this.
sentences.zh: 但洛林对此表示异议。

sentences.en: She said her husband hadn't arrived home until after 5pm and he'd immediately stripped off his clothes and put them in the washing machine.
sentences.zh: 她说丈夫直到下午5点多才到家，而且一进门就脱掉衣服扔进了洗衣机。

sentences.en: It was the first time she had ever seen Lowe do laundry in his life.
sentences.zh: 这是她这辈子第一次见到洛洗衣服。

sentences.en: Now harbouring the same suspicions as Margaret Hobbs and Victoria Police,
sentences.zh: 现在，怀着与玛格丽特·霍布斯和维多利亚州警方同样的怀疑，

sentences.en: Lorraine asked Lowe to move out of their house.
sentences.zh: 洛林要求洛搬出他们的家。

sentences.en: He began residing at their holiday home in Rosebud, not far from where Cherie Beasley had been abducted.
sentences.zh: 他开始住在罗斯巴德的度假屋里，距离切丽·比斯利被绑架的地方不远。

sentences.en: His employer fired him and handed over his company car to detectives.
sentences.zh: 他的雇主解雇了他，并将他的公司用车交给了侦探。

sentences.en: But Lowe assured Margaret that he wasn't worried.
sentences.zh: 但洛向玛格丽特保证他并不担心。

sentences.en: He wasn't guilty.
sentences.zh: 他是无辜的。

sentences.en: And if the police had any evidence, he would have been arrested and charged by now.
sentences.zh: 如果警方有任何证据，他现在早就被逮捕和起诉了。

sentences.en: Soon enough, all of his troubles would fade and life would return to normal.
sentences.zh: 很快，他所有的麻烦都会消失，生活也会恢复正常。

sentences.en: Three months after Cherie Beasley was abducted, some teenage horse riders were travelling along a country road in Red Hill, a rural town about 10km inland from Rosebud.
sentences.zh: 切丽·比斯利被绑架三个月后，一些骑马的青少年沿着红山的一条乡村道路行驶，那是一个距离罗斯巴德内陆约10公里的农村小镇。

sentences.en: Suddenly, the teenage girls smelled a foul odour.
sentences.zh: 突然，这些少女闻到了一股恶臭。

sentences.en: One of their horses spooked as they passed a concrete stormwater pipe that jutted out beneath the driveway of a property.
sentences.zh: 当她们经过一根从车道下方伸出的混凝土雨水管时，其中一匹马受惊了。

sentences.en: Squeezed inside the pipe's narrow 30cm entrance was a badly decomposed corpse that the girls initially believed belonged to a kangaroo.
sentences.zh: 在管子狭窄的30厘米入口处，挤着一具高度腐烂的尸体，女孩们起初以为是袋鼠。

sentences.en: When they passed the same spot the following day, the remains had been dragged out into the open, presumably by scavenging animals.
sentences.zh: 第二天她们经过同一地点时，遗体已经被拖到了空地上，大概是被食腐动物弄的。

sentences.en: In the harsh light of day, it was clear they belonged not to a kangaroo, but to a small human.
sentences.zh: 在刺眼的日光下，很明显那不是袋鼠，而是一个小人。

sentences.en: They were lying on a dirty, bright pink jumper, an article of clothing that matched the pink tracksuit Cherie Beasley had been wearing on the day of her disappearance.
sentences.zh: 遗体躺在一件肮脏的亮粉色套头衫上，这件衣服与切丽·比斯利失踪当天穿的粉色运动服相符。

sentences.en: Forensic testing confirmed that the body was hers, but she was too badly decomposed for a cause of death to be established.
sentences.zh: 法医鉴定证实尸体确实是她，但由于腐烂严重，无法确定死因。

sentences.en: Margaret Hobbs learned about the heartbreaking discovery in the news.
sentences.zh: 玛格丽特·霍布斯从新闻中得知了这个令人心碎的发现。

sentences.en: She had been following Cherie's case closely ever since she'd grown suspicious of Robert Lowe.
sentences.zh: 自从对罗伯特·洛产生怀疑以来，她一直密切关注着切丽的案件。

sentences.en: After Lowe's long absence from her life, he had started making regular appointments again.
sentences.zh: 在洛长时间消失后，他又开始定期预约咨询。

sentences.en: Away from his family and with the police watching him closely,
sentences.zh: 远离家人，且受到警方密切监视，

sentences.en: Lowe had grown to view Margaret as his primary confidant.
sentences.zh: 洛已经开始将玛格丽特视为他主要的倾诉对象。

sentences.en: When Margaret first saw Lowe after Cherie's remains were recovered, she remarked,
sentences.zh: 当切丽的遗体被发现后，玛格丽特第一次见到洛时，她评论道：

sentences.en: I believe they've found the body of Cherie Beasley.
sentences.zh: “我想他们已经找到了切丽·比斯利的尸体。”

sentences.en: Lowe appeared unfazed and merely replied,
sentences.zh: 洛显得无动于衷，只是回答说：

sentences.en: Have they?
sentences.zh: “是吗？”

sentences.en: Then he abruptly added,
sentences.zh: 然后他突然补充道：

sentences.en: I don't know the spot where they found it.
sentences.zh: “我不知道他们发现尸体的地方。”

sentences.en: I've never been there.
sentences.zh: “我从来没去过那里。”

sentences.en: I wouldn't have a clue where it was.
sentences.zh: “我根本不知道那是在哪儿。”

sentences.en: Margaret had mentioned nothing about the body's location.

sentences.zh: 安静地坐在隔壁公寓里，监听了玛格丽特与罗伯特·洛的最新一次会谈。

sentences.en: To their shock, Lowe began to detail how he had driven to Rosebud on Saturday, June 29, 1991, and picked up Cherie Beasley.
sentences.zh: 令他们震惊的是，洛开始详细描述他是如何在1991年6月29日星期六开车去罗斯巴德并接走切丽·比斯利的。

sentences.en: He described how she had panicked and choked to death in his passenger seat, and the way he had subsequently disposed of her body.
sentences.zh: 他描述了她如何惊慌失措并在他的副驾驶座上窒息而死，以及他随后处理她尸体的方式。

sentences.en: Then he told Margaret he needed to visit Red Hill.
sentences.zh: 然后他告诉玛格丽特他需要去一趟红山。

sentences.en: Seeing the exact spot where he had left the little girl might jog his memory further.
sentences.zh: 看看他留下那个小女孩的确切地点可能会进一步唤起他的记忆。

sentences.en: The two detectives stared at each other.
sentences.zh: 两位侦探面面相觑。

sentences.en: They finally had him.
sentences.zh: 他们终于抓到他了。

sentences.en: Detective Barch and another officer soon paid a visit to Margaret's office.
sentences.zh: 巴奇侦探和另一名警官很快拜访了玛格丽特的办公室。

sentences.en: When she told them of her plans to drive Lowe to Red Hill, they told her they would need to monitor the trip for her own safety.
sentences.zh: 当她告诉他们她计划开车带洛去红山时，他们告诉她，为了她自己的安全，他们需要监控这次行程。

sentences.en: Detectives would tail them out to the location, and Margaret would be given a panic button she could press if she began to feel unsafe.
sentences.zh: 侦探们会跟踪他们前往该地点，玛格丽特会得到一个紧急按钮，如果她感到不安全，可以按下它。

sentences.en: But, without her knowledge, the police also did something else.
sentences.zh: 但是，在玛格丽特不知情的情况下，警方还做了另一件事。

sentences.en: They installed a covert listening device in her car so that they could hear everything that was said throughout the journey.
sentences.zh: 他们在她的车里安装了一个秘密监听装置，以便他们能听到整个旅程中说的每一句话。

sentences.en: A few days after Margaret took Lowe to Red Hill, detectives obtained a statement about the trip from Margaret.
sentences.zh: 在玛格丽特带洛去红山几天后，侦探们从玛格丽特那里获得了一份关于这次行程的陈述。

sentences.en: The experience had fundamentally changed something in her.
sentences.zh: 这次经历从根本上改变了她。

sentences.en: Before, she had felt a professional discomfort about working with the police against her client.
sentences.zh: 以前，她对配合警方调查自己的客户感到职业上的不安。

sentences.en: Now, she felt she had to help hold him responsible for the terrible thing he had done.
sentences.zh: 现在，她觉得她必须帮助让他为所犯下的可怕罪行负责。

sentences.en: She began recording her sessions with him, though she didn't tell anyone she was doing so.
sentences.zh: 她开始录下与他的会谈，尽管她没有告诉任何人她在这样做。

sentences.en: Meanwhile, the detectives collated their evidence.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，侦探们整理了他们的证据。

sentences.en: On March 31, 1993, they finally struck, arresting Robert Lowe at a backpacker hostel he was now staying at in the Melbourne suburb of St Kilda.
sentences.zh: 1993年3月31日，他们终于采取了行动，在罗伯特·洛目前居住的墨尔本圣基尔达郊区的一家背包客旅馆逮捕了他。

sentences.en: He refused to speak with them, instead insisting they call his lawyer.
sentences.zh: 他拒绝与他们交谈，反而坚持要他们给他的律师打电话。

sentences.en: Then, he proudly told Detective Alex Barch that he was just like Jesus ChriSt.
sentences.zh: 然后，他自豪地告诉亚历克斯·巴奇侦探，他就像耶稣基督一样。

sentences.en: He would have to endure a terrible trial, but all would be right in the end.
sentences.zh: 他将不得不忍受一场可怕的审判，但最终一切都会好起来的。

sentences.en: As described in the book The Evil,
sentences.zh: 正如书《邪恶》中所述，

sentences.en: Detective Barch retorted that Lowe was half right, but he had no chance of being resurrected.
sentences.zh: 巴奇侦探反驳说洛说对了一半，但他根本没有复活的机会。

sentences.en: When Lowe later appeared in Melbourne's magistrate's court, he was greeted by a crowd of journalists, news crews, and angry members of the public.
sentences.zh: 当洛后来出现在墨尔本地方法院时，他受到了大批记者、新闻摄制组和愤怒公众的迎接。

sentences.en: Cherie Beasley's mother, Kerry, had travelled to the city so she could see the man accused of her daughter's murder finally in handcuffs.
sentences.zh: 切丽·比斯利的母亲克里赶到了城里，这样她就能亲眼看到那个被控谋杀她女儿的男人终于戴上了手铐。

sentences.en: When Lowe was brought into the dock, the grief-stricken Kerry screamed abuse and attempted to run over to him before being restrained.
sentences.zh: 当洛被带进被告席时，悲痛欲绝的克里尖叫着辱骂他，并试图冲向他，随后被制止。

sentences.en: Robert Lowe was charged with the abduction and murder of Cherie Beasley, denied bail, and taken into remand to await his trial.
sentences.zh: 罗伯特·洛被控绑架和谋杀切丽·比斯利，被拒绝保释，并被还押候审。

sentences.en: When it came to the details of Cherie's murder, investigators had never believed Lowe's version of events.
sentences.zh: 当谈到切丽谋杀案的细节时，调查人员从未相信洛的说法。

sentences.en: His story that she had agreed to get into his car directly contrasted with the description given by Shane, the little boy who Cherie had been playing with.
sentences.zh: 他声称切丽同意上他的车，这与切丽曾一起玩耍的小男孩谢恩所描述的情况截然相反。

sentences.en: No doubt, Lowe's claim that she had choked while panicking was another attempt to cover up the truth of his crimes.
sentences.zh: 毫无疑问，洛声称她在惊慌中窒息而死，是掩盖他罪行真相的又一尝试。

sentences.en: As Cherie's remains had been so badly decomposed, it was impossible to determine exactly what she had endured or what caused her death.
sentences.zh: 由于切丽的遗骸腐烂严重，无法确定她到底遭受了什么或是什么导致了她的死亡。

sentences.en: As detailed in the book The Evil, three weeks after Lowe was charged,
sentences.zh: 正如书《邪恶》中所详述，在洛被起诉三周后，

sentences.en: Detective Alex Bartsch received some intriguing information from a colleague in Victoria Police's prison squad.
sentences.zh: 亚历克斯·巴奇侦探从维多利亚州警方监狱小组的一位同事那里收到了一些有趣的信息。

sentences.en: An inmate at Melbourne's notorious Pentridge Prison was sharing a cell with Robert Lowe while the latter was awaiting trial.
sentences.zh: 墨尔本臭名昭著的彭特里奇监狱的一名囚犯在洛候审期间与他同住一个牢房。

sentences.en: Peter Reid was a violent criminal who had been convicted of murdering a police officer in 1982.
sentences.zh: 彼得·里德是一名暴力罪犯，曾因在1982年谋杀一名警官而被定罪。

sentences.en: During a series of conversations with Reid,
sentences.zh: 在与里德的一系列谈话中，

sentences.en: Lowe had supposedly made some admissions about Cherie's murder, providing a different version of events than he'd given to police.
sentences.zh: 洛据称承认了切丽的谋杀案，提供了与他告诉警方时不同的版本。

sentences.en: Depending on a jailhouse snitch for evidence was always risky.
sentences.zh: 依靠监狱线人提供证据总是充满风险。

sentences.en: Those who knew Reid said he was dangerous, manipulative, and not to be trusted.
sentences.zh: 认识里德的人说他危险、善于操纵，不可信。

sentences.en: But the information he was providing also seemed consistent with the Robert Lowe police had become familiar with through his psychotherapy sessions.
sentences.zh: 但里德提供的信息似乎也与警方通过心理治疗会谈所了解到的罗伯特·洛相一致。

sentences.en: It was agreed that Peter Reid would wear a wire and attempt to cajole more information from his cellmate.
sentences.zh: 双方商定，彼得·里德将佩戴窃听器，试图从他的狱友那里套出更多信息。

sentences.en: Reid's strategy was to tell Lowe that he knew a lawyer who could create a fake story for Lowe's defence, but only if he was given a true account of what had really happened.
sentences.zh: 里德的策略是告诉洛，他认识一位律师，可以为洛的辩护编造一个虚假故事，但前提是他必须如实讲述到底发生了什么。

sentences.en: He needed to draw upon facts when designing a false narrative.
sentences.zh: 他在设计虚假叙述时需要利用事实。

sentences.en: Lowe fell for it.
sentences.zh: 洛上当了。

sentences.en: He gave Reid a very different story, admitting that he'd seen Cherie in the area on several previous occasions before abducting her.
sentences.zh: 他给了里德一个完全不同的故事，承认他在绑架切丽之前，曾多次在那个地区看到过她。

sentences.en: Each time, she had been riding her bike to the local shops where she sometimes ran errands for her mother.
sentences.zh: 每次她都是骑自行车去当地商店，有时会为她母亲跑腿。

sentences.en: Lowe had followed her, making a note of where she lived, and decided to abduct her.
sentences.zh: 洛一直跟着她，记下了她住的地方，并决定绑架她。

sentences.en: He went to Rosebud on June 29, 1991, with the express purpose of taking the little girl.
sentences.zh: 他于1991年6月29日前往罗斯巴德，目的就是为了带走那个小女孩。

sentences.en: After forcing Cherie into his car, he drove her to a remote farmland area, where he brutally raped her.
sentences.zh: 在强行将切丽塞进车里后，他把她带到了一个偏远的农田地区，在那里残忍地强奸了她。

sentences.en: Cherie had cried and begged to be taken home to her mother.
sentences.zh: 切丽哭着恳求被送回家找妈妈。

sentences.en: Lowe maintained that while she had choked to death, this hadn't been due to a panic attack.
sentences.zh: 洛坚称，虽然她窒息而死，但这并不是因为惊恐发作。

sentences.en: Instead, it had resulted directly from him assaulting her.
sentences.zh: 相反，这是他侵犯她直接导致的结果。

sentences.en: When Cherie started to choke,
sentences.zh: 当切丽开始窒息时，

sentences.en: Lowe removed the pink bike helmet that she was still wearing.
sentences.zh: 洛摘下了她当时还戴着的粉色自行车头盔。

sentences.en: He later discarded it somewhere.
sentences.zh: 他后来把它丢弃在了某个地方。

sentences.en: After realising that Cherie was dead,
sentences.zh: 在意识到切丽已经死亡后，

sentences.en: Lowe drove down a country road and pushed and kicked her underwear-clad body into the stormwater drain where she was later found.
sentences.zh: 洛沿着一条乡村公路开车，将她衣衫不整的尸体推踢进了雨水渠，后来她就是在那里被发现的。

sentences.en: His semen had stained most of Cherie's clothing, so he threw the garments away in a rubbish skip.
sentences.zh: 他的精液沾满了雪莉的大部分衣物，于是他把这些衣服扔进了一个垃圾箱。

sentences.en: When Reed met with Detective Barch after obtaining this confession, the detective noticed how pale and sick the convicted criminal appeared.
sentences.zh: 当里德在获得这份供词后与巴奇警探会面时，警探注意到这位罪犯看起来是多么苍白和虚弱。

sentences.en: Listening to Lowe's admissions over the course of multiple days had clearly taken a severe mental and emotional toll on him.
sentences.zh: 在多天的时间里听取洛的供述，显然对他造成了严重的心理和情感创伤。

sentences.en: Despite this, he thanked Detective Barch for giving him the opportunity to assist in convicting a child killer.
sentences.zh: 尽管如此，他还是感谢巴奇警探给了他协助将杀童犯绳之以法的机会。

sentences.en: Robert Lowe's trial finally began in October 1994, more than three years after
sentences.zh: 罗伯特·洛的审判终于在1994年10月开始，距离

sentences.en: Cherie Beasley was murdered.
sentences.zh: 雪莉·比斯利遇害已经过去了三年多。

sentences.en: The prosecution alleged that the crime had been carefully planned and premeditated by Lowe, who clearly had a fascination with such crimes, as evidenced by his obsession
sentences.zh: 检方指控这起罪行是洛精心策划和预谋的，他显然对这类犯罪有着浓厚的兴趣，这一点从他对他人的痴迷中可见一斑

sentences.en: with the Carmen Chan case.
sentences.zh: 卡门·陈案。

sentences.en: Margaret Hobbs was the prosecution's star witness.
sentences.zh: 玛格丽特·霍布斯是检方的关键证人。

sentences.en: She testified over four days, and sections of the secret recordings that had been made of her sessions with Lowe were played for the court.
sentences.zh: 她作证了四天，法庭上还播放了她与洛会谈时秘密录音的部分片段。

sentences.en: Lowe's cellmate,
sentences.zh: 洛的狱友，

sentences.en: Peter Reid also gave evidence about his own taped conversations with Lowe.
sentences.zh: 彼得·里德也提供了关于他自己与洛录音对话的证据。

sentences.en: As detailed in The Evil, everyone present in the courtroom listened attentively as Reid made a personal address to the jury.
sentences.zh: 正如《罪恶》一书中所详述的那样，当里德向陪审团发表个人陈述时，法庭上的每个人都全神贯注地聆听。

sentences.en: He described himself as one of the worst criminals in the system, but said that even he was shocked and angered by Cherie's murder.
sentences.zh: 他形容自己是体制内最糟糕的罪犯之一，但表示连他自己都对雪莉的谋杀案感到震惊和愤怒。

sentences.en: That was why he had decided to testify for the prosecution.
sentences.zh: 这就是他决定为检方作证的原因。

sentences.en: This admission held Reid in good stead with the jury, despite the defence's attempts to undermine his credibility as a witness.
sentences.zh: 尽管辩方试图削弱他作为证人的可信度，但这一供述让里德在陪审团面前赢得了好感。

sentences.en: Throughout the duration of the trial,
sentences.zh: 在整个审判过程中，

sentences.en: Robert Lowe showed little emotion.
sentences.zh: 罗伯特·洛几乎没有流露任何情绪。

sentences.en: He sat in the dock with a blank expression.
sentences.zh: 他坐在被告席上，面无表情。

sentences.en: As one reporter, who was quoted in The Evil, wrote,
sentences.zh: 正如《罪恶》中引用的一位记者所写的那样，

sentences.en: The only hint of feeling behind his bespectacled and grey-bearded visage was a nervous facial twitch.
sentences.zh: 他那戴着眼镜、留着灰白胡须的面容下，唯一流露出的情感迹象是神经质的面部抽搐。

sentences.en: It surfaced when witnesses gave evidence that sat uncomfortably with his version of events.
sentences.zh: 当证人提供的证据与他的陈述不符时，这种抽搐就会出现。

sentences.en: A month after the trial began, the jury retired to consider their verdict.
sentences.zh: 审判开始一个月后，陪审团退庭商议裁决。

sentences.en: After five hours, they returned.
sentences.zh: 五小时后，他们回来了。

sentences.en: They had found Robert Lowe guilty of abducting and murdering Cherie Beasley.
sentences.zh: 他们裁定罗伯特·洛绑架并谋杀雪莉·比斯利的罪名成立。

sentences.en: When Cherie's mother,
sentences.zh: 当雪莉的母亲，

sentences.en: Kerry, heard the verdict, she cried out,
sentences.zh: 克里听到裁决时，她大喊道：

sentences.en: Suffer, Lowe.
sentences.zh: 受苦吧，洛。

sentences.en: Cherie got her revenge this time.
sentences.zh: 雪莉这次报仇了。

sentences.en: Rot in hell.
sentences.zh: 在地狱里腐烂吧。

sentences.en: The public gallery clapped and cheered.
sentences.zh: 旁听席上响起了掌声和欢呼声。

sentences.en: Lowe's face remained impassive, but he blinked several times upon learning his fate.
sentences.zh: 洛的脸依然冷漠，但在得知自己的命运时，他眨了几下眼睛。

sentences.en: His ex-wife Lorraine fainted and the couple's two sons rushed to her aid, followed shortly by paramedics.
sentences.zh: 他的前妻洛林晕倒了，这对夫妇的两个儿子冲过去救助她，随后医护人员也赶到了。

sentences.en: The sentencing judge teared up as he gave Robert Lowe life in prison for murder and 15 years for the abduction charge.
sentences.zh: 量刑法官在判处罗伯特·洛谋杀罪终身监禁、绑架罪15年监禁时流下了眼泪。

sentences.en: He refused to give a minimum term, describing the trial as the most harrowing he had ever experienced.
sentences.zh: 他拒绝给出最低刑期，称这次审判是他经历过最令人痛苦的审判。

sentences.en: Addressing Lowe directly, he stated,
sentences.zh: 他直接对洛说道：

sentences.en: What you did was every child's fear and every parent's nightmare.
sentences.zh: 你所做的一切是每个孩子的恐惧，也是每个父母的噩梦。

sentences.en: When Robert Lowe was removed from the courtroom,
sentences.zh: 当罗伯特·洛被带离法庭时，

sentences.en: Kerry shouted,
sentences.zh: 克里喊道：

sentences.en: Just remember Lowe,
sentences.zh: 记住，洛，

sentences.en: Cherie got a death sentence.
sentences.zh: 雪莉被判了死刑。

sentences.en: You've still got your life.
sentences.zh: 而你还活着。

sentences.en: Despite bringing a child killer to justice,
sentences.zh: 尽管将杀童犯绳之以法，

sentences.en: Margaret Hobbs had battled with her decision to assist the police and then testify against him.
sentences.zh: 玛格丽特·霍布斯还是在协助警方并出庭指证他这一决定上挣扎不已。

sentences.en: As a psychotherapist, she felt she had an obligation to keep the things her clients told her in confidence and had indicated to Robert Lowe that she would never
sentences.zh: 作为一名心理治疗师，她觉得有义务对客户私下告诉她的事情保密，并曾向罗伯特·洛表示她永远不会

sentences.en: disclose what went on during their sessions.
sentences.zh: 透露他们在会谈期间发生的事情。

sentences.en: But, she was so disturbed by the things he told her and the brutality of his actions, she felt she had no choice but to help the investigation.
sentences.zh: 但是，她被他告诉她的事情以及他行为的残暴程度深深困扰，她觉得除了协助调查别无选择。

sentences.en: Many praised
sentences.zh: 许多人称赞

sentences.en: Margaret Hobbs for her actions, while others criticised her for breaking patient therapist confidentiality.
sentences.zh: 玛格丽特·霍布斯的行为，而另一些人则批评她打破了医患保密原则。

sentences.en: She accepted what her critics had to say, content in the knowledge that she had done what she knew to be right.
sentences.zh: 她接受了批评者的意见，因为她确信自己做了她认为正确的事情，对此感到心安。

sentences.en: Robert Lowe lodged an appeal against his conviction, arguing that evidence from his appointments with Margaret shouldn't have been allowed at trial due to confidentiality issues.
sentences.zh: 罗伯特·洛对他的定罪提出上诉，辩称由于保密问题，他在与玛格丽特会面时的证据不应在审判中被采纳。

sentences.en: His appeal was rejected and the court made clear that public interest overrides confidentiality in situations where an individual in therapy has committed a serious crime.
sentences.zh: 他的上诉被驳回，法院明确表示，在接受治疗的个人犯下严重罪行的情况下，公共利益高于保密原则。

sentences.en: Margaret Hobbs was left traumatised by her dealings with Robert Lowe.
sentences.zh: 玛格丽特·霍布斯因与罗伯特·洛的接触而留下了心理创伤。

sentences.en: Learning of the terrible things he had done took a serious toll on her health and wellbeing and she suffered insomnia and nightmares.
sentences.zh: 得知他所做的可怕事情对她的健康和幸福造成了严重影响，她患上了失眠症和噩梦。

sentences.en: She wrote of the experience,
sentences.zh: 她写道：

sentences.en: I took to staring at children who I judged to be aged about six, watching their movements and imagining.
sentences.zh: 我开始盯着那些我判断大约六岁的孩子，观察他们的动作并展开想象。

sentences.en: One day I found a little lost girl who was about this age.
sentences.zh: 有一天，我发现了一个大约这个年纪的小女孩迷路了。

sentences.en: She had lost her mother and was sobbing and stuttering out her name.
sentences.zh: 她和母亲走散了，正在抽泣着结结巴巴地喊着母亲的名字。

sentences.en: We found her mother and I sat in my car and cried, aware of the terror of the child at having lost her mother for ten minutes.
sentences.zh: 我们找到了她的母亲，我坐在车里哭了，意识到孩子因为失去母亲十分钟而感到的恐惧。

sentences.en: Margaret began working on a book about the case.
sentences.zh: 玛格丽特开始撰写一本关于此案的书。

sentences.en: Then, almost six years after Cherie's murder on
